__comment: Grape vine — surface-only perennial vine, primary ingredient for wine.
Must be grown on designated surface dirt farm plots with open sky.
Perennial: after harvest the vine remains in the 'fruiting' stage and re-readies
each summer. Dwarves only need to plant cuttings once.
Grapes are harvested in SUMMER and AUTUMN only (season_only constraints on yields).
Winter: the vine goes dormant and displays a bare-cane model. The fruiting stage
does not reset — it resumes as fruiting in spring and yields again in summer.
Unlike the annual hops plant, grape vines survive winter and never return to FALLOW
unless the farm plot is explicitly cleared by the player.
